'''Jorge Alberto López''' (born 1955 in Monterrey, Mexico<ref>{{cite book |last=Rosenthal |first=Judith |title=Teaching Science to Language Minority Students: Theory and Practice |publisher=Multilingual Matters|date=1996 |page=146 |url= https://books.google.com/books?id=nmPuWg3Wt4cC|isbn=9781853592720 }}</ref>) is a physicist and educator and the Schumaker Professor of Physics at the [[University of Texas at El Paso]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.science.utep.edu/physics/index.php/about-us/faculty-and-staff |title=Faculty Page |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |website=UTEP Physics Department |access-date=8 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180630214046/https://www.science.utep.edu/physics/index.php/about-us/faculty-and-staff |archive-date=30 June 2018 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He is known for his work in [[High energy nuclear physics|heavy ion collision]] dynamics<ref name="bouchet">{{cite web |url=http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?last_nm=Lopez&first_nm=Jorge&year=2015 |title=2015 Edward A. Bouchet Award Recipient |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.-->  |website=American Physical Society |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref> and for his outreach to the [[Hispanic and Latino Americans|Hispanic]] community in the United States to increase diversity in physics, effective teaching and mentoring of undergraduate students (particularly underrepresented minorities), development of bilingual physics education programs, and building collaborations between American and Latin American universities.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.science.org/content/article/physics-mentoring-mexico-us-border |title=Physics Mentoring on the Mexico-U.S. Border |last=Lopez |first=Jorge | website=Science |access-date= 8 June 2016|date=2002-04-12 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.aps.org/publications/apsnews/201502/bouchet.cfm |title=Bridge-builder to Hispanic Community Wins Bouchet Award |last=Lucibella |first=Michael | website=American Physical Society News |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref> He is one of the founders of the [[National Society of Hispanic Physicists]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.hispanicphysicists.org/history.html |title=A Brief History of Our Society |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.-->  |website=National Society of Hispanic Physicists |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref> and author of books on nuclear physics, surface science, and statistical analysis of elections.

==Awards==
*2018 [[Nature (journal) | Nature]] Mentoring Award<ref>{{cite journal |title=How four winning mentors help to build skills and dispel doubt |author=Woolston, Chris  |journal=Nature |volume=565 |issue=7738 |pages=255–257 |doi=10.1038/d41586-019-00039-7 |year=2019 |pmid=30622363 |bibcode=2019Natur.565..255W |doi-access=free }}</ref>
*2018 [[Texas A&M University]] College of Science Distinguished Former Student<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.science.tamu.edu/news/story.php?story_ID=1949 |title=Texas A&M Science to Induct Two into Academy of Distinguished Former Students |author=Hutchins, Shana  |website=Texas A&M College of Science |access-date= 2 April 2018}}</ref>
*2016 [[University of Texas System]] Regents Outstanding Teaching Award<ref>[https://wiki.utep.edu/download/attachments/39715320/UTEP%20Jorge%20Lopez-ROTA%20Congrat%20Ltr%2006-03-16.pdf UT System Regents' Award]</ref>
*2015 [[American Physical Society]] Edward A. Bouchet Award<ref name="bouchet"/>
*2014 [[President of the United States | White House]] Presidential Award for Excellence in Science, Mathematics, & Engineering Mentoring<ref>{{cite web |url=http://paesmem.com/node/2611 |title=Jorge Lopez profile at PAESMEM |website=PAESMEM |access-date= 15 January 2019}}</ref>
*2014 [[American Physical Society]] Division of Nuclear Physics Mentoring Award<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.aps.org/units/dnp/awards/mentoring.cfm |title=Mentoring Award |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.-->  |website=American Physical Society Division of Nuclear Physics |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref>
*2011 [[Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers]] Educator of the Year Award<ref>{{cite web |url=http://admin.utep.edu/Default.aspx?tabid=70312 |title=Science Society Names UTEP Professor as Top Educator |last=Perez |first=Daniel  |website=News @ UTEP |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref>
*2010 [[Society of Mexican American Engineers and Scientists]] Outstanding MAEStro Award<ref>{{cite web |url=http://science.utep.edu/physics/index.php/50-news-archive |title=Physics Professor is awarded MAES Outstanding Maestro Award |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.-->  |website=UTEP Physics Department News Archive |access-date= 8 June 2016}}</ref>
*2007 [[American Physical Society]] Fellow<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=&unit_id=FIP&institution=University+of+Texas |title=APS Fellow Archive |website=American Physical Society |access-date= 15 January 2019}}</ref>
